_golden: GOLDEN REFERENCE (arc human-story: health, care, education, kids & family, brand & mission). Study it, then write YOUR product's film from YOUR docs. Do not copy its lines, its numbers or its product. It is not buildable (no materials). Every _why says what a top crew did and why.
_facts: The docs this film was written from (fictional service): Northside Physio, Leeds. Open until 9 pm on weekdays. First assessment: 45 minutes. You see the same physiotherapist every visit. Three physiotherapists. Book online or by phone. Most physio clinics in Leeds close by 5 pm (our survey of 20 clinics, 2026). Approved quote from a patient, Sam (permission on file): 'I booked after work and kept the job.'

_anchors.proposition: Care should fit around the work that hurts you.
_anchors.concept: After five — the clinic opens its doors when office hours close
_anchors.hook: Your back hurts from work. Most clinics in Leeds close at five.
_anchors.last: Come after five. We're here until nine.
_anchors._why: A human truth (the timing problem) is the tension; the service is the release. The real quote is the proof, used only because it is approved. The last line repeats the hook's hour and resolves it.

scenes._why: The whole cover is a cold open in two beats (it opens on the subject at `focus`, then pulls back to the place): no logo, no name; the brand lands at the hero and the end card. Two short true sentences make the tension in under 3 s; the second is from the clinic's own survey (see _facts), so it can be said. No product yet.

say.zh: 腰是上班累坏的，利兹的诊所却大多五点关门。

scenes._why: A person and a place at the hour that matters. The title is the time on the clock, not a slogan.

say.en: At Northside in Leeds, the lights are still on.
say.zh: 在利兹的 Northside，灯还亮着。

scenes._why: How it helps, in two facts a patient cares about. 'The same physio every visit' is a promise people feel; 'personalised care' is not.

say.en: A forty-five minute first assessment, and the same physio every time you come back.

scenes._why: Hero at ~65 %, after the quiet quote: the evening desk from the cold open returns, transformed: it starts tight and dim, and on the downbeat pulls back to the whole frame and lights up, holds alone for ~2.5 s, then the name (a bookend that changes, not a repeat), with the proposition in three words.
The callback answers the hook's 'five' with 'nine'. The booking details are in the contacts.
